newsitem.title: USA: USG jet fuel prices jump, tracking NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: USG jet fuel prices jump, tracking NYMEX rally.

text.p: U.S. Gulf jet fuel prices surged higher, tracking the sharp gains seen on the NYMEX on Tuesday.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for delivery on the back 13th cycle of the Colonial Pipeline was talked between about 1.00 and 0.75 cents under the screen, near unchanged on the day, traders said.
However, June heating oil on the NYMEX jumped 1.33 cents by the settlement, driving outright prices up.
The market was expected to take its near-term direction from the American Petroleum Institute report due out Tuesday evening.
"If we get a bullish API report, this thing could close in on 60.00 cents," one trader said.
